public agencies can help by sharing regional chemistry forecasts and making technical guidance understandable to small producers. access to timely information is part of adaptation, just like access to treatment equipment. giai thich co trach nhiem neu dia diem, bien so, don vi, do sau va khoang lay mau. can phan biet ph voi do bao hoa carbonate, bien dong ngan han voi xu the dai han. voi sinh ke ven bien, quan trac chi huu ich khi thong tin den nguoi nuoi kip thoi de ung pho. can ho tro co so nho khong du kha nang tu mua cam bien, thiet bi xu ly hay chiu dong cua tam thoi.

thu nghiem huu ich bat dau bang cam bien chi phi thap o dau lay nuoc va nhat ky lien ket hoa hoc voi tung lua au trung. trai giong co the doi chieu ty le song, phat trien vo trong giai doan ph binh thuong va thap, roi chia se ket qua voi co so lan can. du lieu vung co the phat hien rui ro mua lap lai va ho tro phoi hop thoi gian lay nuoc. co quan quan ly nen giup trai nho tiep can hieu chuan, bao tri thay vi yeu cau thiet bi dat ma khong ho tro. bao cao cong khai khong nen xem phan ung cua mot trai la pho quat; loai, nguon nuoc va thiet ke san xuat deu anh huong hieu qua.

co quan cong co the chia se du bao hoa hoc vung va dien giai huong dan ky thuat cho nguoi nuoi nho. tiep can thong tin kip thoi la mot phan cua thich ung, cung nhu tiep can thiet bi xu ly.
satellite-altimetry-sea-level-2025:
do muc bien bang ve tinh do cao satellite altimetry tracks sea level across the open ocean chuoi ve tinh toan cau tu 1993 den 2024 cho thay muc bien tang va toc do gia tang; ve tinh do cao bo sung quan trac rong nhung can hieu chinh, tram trieu va neu ro giai doan so sanh. satellite altimetry sends radar pulses toward the ocean and measures the return time to estimate the distance between satellite and sea surface. combining that range with the spacecraft’s precisely known orbit gives sea-surface height. repeated tracks build a global picture, including remote areas with few tide gauges. the method measures the sea surface relative to a reference frame, not a local flood depth at a house. ve tinh do cao phat xung radar xuong bien va do thoi gian phan hoi de uoc luong khoang cach giua ve tinh va mat nuoc. ket hop khoang cach voi quy dao tau da biet chinh xac cho ra cao do mat bien. duong bay lap lai tao buc tranh toan cau, ke ca noi xa it tram trieu. phuong phap do mat bien theo he quy chieu, khong do do sau ngap o mot ngoi nha. nasa’s global indicator shows a rise of roughly 10 centimetres between 1993 and 2024, with acceleration over the satellite era. that is a global mean trend assembled from calibrated missions, not a claim that sea level rose exactly that amount at every coast. the published estimate is dated and may be updated as processing methods and reference data improve. chi so toan cau cua nasa cho thay muc tang khoang 10 cm tu 1993 den 2024, voi toc do tang trong ky nguyen ve tinh. day la xu the trung binh toan cau tong hop tu cac nhiem vu da hieu chinh, khong phai tuyen bo moi bo bien deu tang dung muc ay. uoc tinh co moc thoi gian va co the cap nhat khi phuong phap xu ly cung du lieu tham chieu duoc cai thien. tide gauges provide a complementary perspective: they measure water relative to land at a fixed point. satellite and gauge records can be compared to detect instrument drift or local vertical land motion. corrections account for atmospheric pressure, waves, tides and orbit errors. these details sound technical, but they are why a sea-level trend is a carefully processed estimate rather than a direct ruler reading. tram trieu cho goc nhin bo sung: do mat nuoc so voi dat tai mot diem co dinh. co the doi chieu du lieu ve tinh va tram de phat hien sai lech thiet bi hay chuyen dong thang dung cua dat. hieu chinh xu ly ap suat khi quyen, song, thuy trieu va sai so quy dao. chi tiet ky thuat nay giai thich vi sao xu the muc bien la uoc luong da xu ly can than chu khong phai so doc truc tiep. the global increase has two major physical contributors: thermal expansion as seawater warms and added water from melting land ice. satellite gravimetry and ocean temperature profiles help separate these contributions. regional patterns differ because winds and currents redistribute water, and the gravitational pull of ice sheets changes as they lose mass. thus the global mean is a reference, not a complete regional forecast. muc bien toan cau tang chu yeu do hai co che vat ly: nuoc bien no khi am len va nuoc tan tu bang tren dat lien bo sung vao bien. do trong luc ve tinh va ho so nhiet do bien giup tach dong gop. mo hinh khu vuc khac nhau do gio, dong bien phan phoi lai nuoc va luc hap dan cua chom bang thay doi khi mat khoi luong. vi the, trung binh toan cau la tham chieu chu khong phai du bao day du tung vung. long-term altimetry is valuable for climate assessment, but short-term variability remains. el nino, ocean circulation and atmospheric patterns can shift water between basins and temporarily steepen or flatten the global curve. researchers publish uncertainty ranges and preserve consistent baselines so users can distinguish a genuine multi-decade trend from seasonal or interannual movement. do cao dai han huu ich cho danh gia khi hau nhung van co dao dong ngan. el nino, hoan luu va mo hinh khi quyen co the dich chuyen nuoc giua cac luu vuc, tam thoi lam duong cong toan cau doc hon hay phang di. nha nghien cuu cong bo khoang bat dinh va duy tri moc so sanh nhat quan de nguoi dung phan biet xu the nhieu thap ky voi bien dong theo mua hay giua cac nam. when a news story reports a new sea-level record, check the date, reference period and whether it means global mean or a regional anomaly. satellite evidence helps governments plan, but a local engineer still needs topography, subsidence, tides and storm statistics. better communication links these scales instead of using a global centimetre figure to imply a precise prediction for one street.

to make a satellite record comparable over decades, scientists connect successive missions, correct for orbital drift and use stable reference measurements. small calibration errors can affect the apparent rate, so independent checks are essential. the record is particularly powerful offshore, where gauges are sparse, but near coasts radar signals can be complicated by land and waves. coastal applications therefore blend satellite data with gauges and local elevation surveys. a responsible chart labels the reference period and uncertainty band, and does not imply that a global trend translates uniformly to every harbour.

consistent units matter in public communication. a rate per year, a total change since 1993 and a projected amount by a future date answer different questions and should not be merged in one headline. khi tin tuc noi muc bien lap ky luc, hay kiem tra ngay, giai doan tham chieu va do la trung binh toan cau hay di thuong khu vuc. du lieu ve tinh ho tro chinh phu quy hoach, nhung ky su dia phuong van can dia hinh, sut lun, thuy trieu va thong ke bao. truyen thong tot ket noi cac quy mo thay vi lay con so toan cau de khang dinh du bao chinh xac cho mot con pho.

de so sanh chuoi ve tinh qua nhieu thap ky, nha khoa hoc noi tiep nhiem vu, hieu chinh lech quy dao va dung phep do tham chieu on dinh. sai so hieu chuan nho co the anh huong toc do uoc tinh, vi vay can kiem tra doc lap. chuoi dac biet huu ich ngoai khoi noi it tram, nhung gan bo tin hieu radar phuc tap do dat lien va song. ung dung ven bien ket hop du lieu ve tinh, tram trieu va khao sat cao do. bieu do co trach nhiem ghi moc chuan, dai bat dinh va khong ham y xu the toan cau chuyen deu toi moi cang.

don vi nhat quan rat quan trong khi truyen thong. toc do moi nam, tong muc doi tu 1993 va luong du bao toi mot moc tuong lai tra loi cac cau hoi khac nhau, khong nen tron vao mot tieu de.
climate-ready-marine-aquaculture-2025:
nuoi bien thich ung voi nang nong va thieu oxy marine farms can use forecasts but cannot control the ocean bao cao fao sofia 2024 cung cac canh bao moi truong 2025 nhan manh nuoi trong thuy san can da dang loai, giam sat oxy, nhiet va ke hoach ung pho dich benh, chu khong chi mo rong san luong. marine aquaculture produces fish, shellfish and seaweed in coastal and offshore waters. it can support food supply and employment, but farms are exposed to the same warming, storms, low oxygen and disease pressures affecting wild ecosystems. climate resilience means maintaining production and livelihoods through shocks, not claiming that a farm can isolate itself from the surrounding ocean. nuoi trong bien san xuat ca, nhuyen the va rong o vung ven bo, ngoai khoi. hoat dong nay ho tro nguon thuc pham va viec lam, nhung trang trai phoi nhiem voi nang nong, bao, thieu oxy va dich benh nhu he sinh thai tu nhien. suc chong chiu khi hau nghia la duy tri san luong va sinh ke qua cu soc, chu khong phai tuyen bo trang trai co the tach khoi dai duong xung quanh. fao’s 2024 state of world fisheries and aquaculture reported continued growth in global aquatic animal production and emphasized sustainable management. by 2025, regional agencies were using more forecasts and real-time monitoring to manage heat and oxygen risks. these dated developments do not mean all aquaculture is sustainable; performance varies with feed, siting, disease controls, labour and the health of receiving waters. bao cao state of world fisheries and aquaculture nam 2024 cua fao ghi nhan san luong dong vat thuy sinh toan cau tiep tuc tang va nhan manh quan ly ben vung. den 2025, co quan khu vuc su dung them du bao va giam sat thoi gian thuc de xu ly rui ro nhiet, oxy. nhung dien bien co moc nam khong co nghia moi mo hinh nuoi deu ben vung; hieu qua khac nhau theo thuc an, vi tri, kiem soat benh, lao dong va suc khoe vung nuoc tiep nhan. heat stress can reduce appetite and growth, while high temperatures may make pathogens more active. low oxygen can occur during calm, stratified conditions or after organic waste decomposes. monitoring temperature and dissolved oxygen at cage depth provides an early signal. forecasts become useful when they are linked to response options such as changing feeding schedules, reducing stocking density or harvesting earlier. stress nhiet lam giam an va tang truong, con nhiet cao co the khien mam benh hoat dong manh. thieu oxy xay ra khi nuoc lang, phan tang hoac sau khi chat thai huu co phan huy. theo doi nhiet do va oxy hoa tan o do sau long cung cap tin hieu som. du bao chi huu ich khi gan voi phuong an nhu doi lich cho an, giam mat do tha hay thu hoach som. farm design shapes exposure. siting cages away from poorly flushed bays, choosing species and strains suited to local conditions, and maintaining contingency oxygen equipment can reduce risk. but moving farms can displace impacts to another ecosystem, and genetically selected stock may create biosecurity concerns if it escapes. environmental review should consider cumulative effects from neighbouring farms, not each lease in isolation. thiet ke trang trai dinh hinh muc phoi nhiem. dat long ngoai vinh it trao doi nuoc, chon loai va dong phu hop dieu kien dia phuong, duy tri thiet bi oxy du phong co the giam rui ro. tuy nhien, chuyen trang trai co the day tac dong sang he sinh thai khac; ca chon giong thoat ra co the gay lo ngai an toan sinh hoc. danh gia moi truong can xet tac dong cong don cua cac co so lan can, khong tach tung giay phep. diversifying species, income and markets can make a coastal business less dependent on one harvest. insurance and emergency credit may help small operators recover, but access can be unequal. worker safety is also part of resilience: storms and harmful algal blooms can make routine work dangerous. plans should state who receives alerts, who can stop operations and how financial losses are shared. da dang loai, nguon thu va thi truong giup doanh nghiep ven bien bot phu thuoc mot vu. bao hiem va tin dung khan cap ho tro co so nho phuc hoi nhung kha nang tiep can khong dong deu. an toan lao dong cung thuoc suc chong chiu: bao va tao doc khien cong viec thuong ngay nguy hiem. ke hoach can neu ai nhan canh bao, ai co quyen dung hoat dong va cach chia se ton that tai chinh. good performance reporting tracks survival, feed conversion, water quality, escapes, disease and labour conditions, alongside production volume. climate-ready aquaculture does not eliminate environmental risk; it anticipates it and limits damage. public agencies can help by making forecast data accessible and enforcing transparent monitoring, while farms invest in adaptable design and avoid expanding beyond the local ecosystem’s capacity.

a farm-level risk register can list the conditions that threaten each species, who checks the sensors and what action follows an alert. a heat threshold may require reduced feeding, while a low-oxygen forecast could prompt harvest or temporary relocation. these decisions involve costs, so extension services and producer groups can share equipment and practical advice. emergency plans should protect workers and avoid unsafe trips during severe weather. after each event, operators can compare the forecast with survival and production records, improving the response without claiming that monitoring can prevent every loss.

public monitoring results can also build trust with nearby residents who worry about waste, escapes or access to the shoreline. publishing routine performance data is more useful than responding only after a harmful incident. bao cao hieu qua tot theo doi ty le song, chuyen doi thuc an, chat luong nuoc, ca thoat, dich benh va dieu kien lao dong cung voi san luong. nuoi bien thich ung khong xoa rui ro moi truong ma du lieu va han che thiet hai. co quan cong co the giup bang cach mo du lieu du bao va thuc thi giam sat minh bach; trang trai dau tu thiet ke linh hoat va khong mo rong vuot suc tai he sinh thai dia phuong.

so dang ky rui ro cap trang trai co the liet ke dieu kien de doa tung loai, nguoi kiem tra cam bien va hanh dong sau canh bao. nguong nhiet co the yeu cau giam cho an, con du bao oxy thap kich hoat thu hoach hay di chuyen tam. quyet dinh nay ton chi phi, nen dich vu khuyen nong va nhom nguoi nuoi co the chia se thiet bi, kinh nghiem. ke hoach khan cap phai bao ve lao dong va tranh chuyen di nguy hiem khi thoi tiet xau. sau moi su kien, co so doi chieu du bao voi ho so song sot, san luong de cai thien ung pho ma khong tuyen bo giam sat ngan duoc moi ton that.

ket qua giam sat cong khai con tao niem tin voi cu dan lo ve chat thai, sinh vat thoat hay loi tiep can bo. cong bo du lieu hieu qua dinh ky huu ich hon chi phan hoi sau su co gay hai.
marine-edna-biodiversity-monitoring-2025:
dna moi truong giup khao sat da dang sinh hoc bien environmental dna expands detection, but does not replace field ecology cac chuong trinh quan trac da dang sinh hoc 2024–2025 mo rong su dung dna moi truong; ket qua phu thuoc vi tri lay mau, dong chay, phan huy vat lieu di truyen va co so du lieu tham chieu. environmental dna, or edna, is genetic material organisms leave in water through cells, mucus, scales or waste. researchers filter water, extract dna and compare sequences with reference databases to detect which species may have been present. the method can reveal elusive or rare organisms without capturing them, but a dna trace is not automatically proof that a living animal is at the exact sampling point. dna moi truong, hay edna, la vat lieu di truyen sinh vat thai vao nuoc qua te bao, chat nhay, vay hay chat thai. nha nghien cuu loc nuoc, tach dna va so sanh chuoi voi co so du lieu tham chieu de phat hien loai co the tung hien dien. phuong phap tim duoc loai hiem hay kho gap ma khong can bat chung, nhung dau vet dna khong tu dong chung minh ca the song o dung diem lay mau. ocean observing programmes increasingly combine conventional surveys with molecular tools. research and monitoring initiatives reported in 2024–2025 use edna to complement biodiversity assessments, especially where visibility is low or habitats are difficult to access. the technology can process many species from one sample, yet comparable results require standardized collection, preservation, laboratory controls and reporting. chuong trinh quan trac bien ngay cang ket hop khao sat truyen thong voi cong cu phan tu. cac sang kien nghien cuu va giam sat 2024–2025 dung edna bo sung danh gia da dang sinh hoc, nhat la noi tam nhin thap hoac sinh canh kho tiep can. cong nghe co the phat hien nhieu loai tu mot mau, nhung can chuan hoa viec lay, bao quan, kiem soat phong thi nghiem va bao cao de ket qua co the so sanh. dna can travel. currents may carry genetic material away from its source, and degradation rates vary with temperature, sunlight and microbial activity. some species shed more material than others. a positive result therefore gives evidence of recent or nearby presence within an uncertain spatial window; a negative result may reflect low abundance, poor sampling or a missing reference sequence rather than true absence. dna co the di chuyen. dong chay mang vat lieu di truyen khoi nguon, con toc do phan huy thay doi theo nhiet, anh sang va vi sinh vat. mot so loai thai nhieu vat lieu hon. ket qua duong tinh cho bang chung ve hien dien gan day hoac gan do trong pham vi khong gian chua chac chan; ket qua am tinh co the do so luong thap, lay mau kem hay thieu chuoi tham chieu chu khong chung minh loai vang mat. contamination is a major concern. dna from boats, people, laboratory reagents or previous samples can create false detections. teams use field blanks, replicate samples and negative controls to identify contamination, while positive controls check whether the method can detect a target. the lab workflow and primer choice should be disclosed so reviewers can understand the limits of the test. nhiem ban la moi lo lon. dna tu tau, nguoi, hoa chat phong lab hay mau truoc do co the tao phat hien gia. nhom dung mau trang hien truong, mau lap va doi chung am de nhan dien nhiem; doi chung duong kiem tra kha nang phat hien muc tieu. quy trinh phong thi nghiem va lua chon doan moi can duoc cong khai de nguoi tham dinh hieu gioi han phep thu. edna is most powerful when paired with visual surveys, acoustic records, specimen vouchers or habitat information. it can guide where to focus a dive survey or reveal that a monitoring programme misses a cryptic species. for conservation decisions, detection should be linked to repeat sampling, abundance estimates and ecological context. a list of species from a single bottle is a starting signal, not a full census. edna hieu qua nhat khi ket hop khao sat truc quan, ghi am, mau vat luu tru hay thong tin sinh canh. no giup xac dinh noi can lan khao sat hoac phat hien chuong trinh giam sat bo sot loai kho quan sat. quyet dinh bao ton can lien ket phat hien voi lay mau lap, uoc tinh so luong va boi canh sinh thai. danh sach loai tu mot chai nuoc chi la tin hieu khoi dau, khong phai kiem ke day du. public reporting should state the sampling location, water depth, date, method and confidence level. reference databases are uneven, especially for under-studied regions, so uncertain identifications should be labelled. open protocols and shared repositories improve comparison across countries. communities can participate in sampling when training and quality controls are available, expanding coverage while respecting local rights over biodiversity information.

an operational edna survey should pre-register target species and sampling locations, preserve chain-of-custody records and use a laboratory blind to site identity where feasible. this reduces the risk that expectations influence interpretation. results should be compared with camera, acoustic or conventional survey data before they inform a protected-area decision. if a rare species is detected, a rapid confirmatory survey can establish whether the signal repeats. publishing negative results is also valuable because it shows where a method had limited sensitivity, rather than creating a misleading impression that only positive detections matter.

community sampling can widen coverage, but training should explain contamination control and safe handling. local participation should include feedback about results and clear agreements on how genetic information will be stored and shared. bao cao cong khai can neu vi tri, do sau, ngay lay mau, phuong phap va muc tin cay. co so du lieu tham chieu khong dong deu, nhat la o khu vuc it nghien cuu, nen dinh danh chua chac can duoc danh dau. quy trinh mo va kho du lieu chung cai thien so sanh giua quoc gia. cong dong co the tham gia lay mau khi duoc dao tao va kiem soat chat luong, mo rong do phu va ton trong quyen dia phuong voi thong tin da dang sinh hoc.

khao sat edna van hanh nen dang ky truoc loai muc tieu, vi tri lay mau, luu ho so ban giao va neu kha thi de phong thi nghiem khong biet danh tinh diem do. dieu do giam nguy co ky vong anh huong dien giai. can so sanh ket qua voi camera, am thanh hay khao sat thong thuong truoc khi dung cho quyet dinh khu bao ton. neu phat hien loai hiem, khao sat xac nhan nhanh giup kiem tra tin hieu co lap lai khong. cong bo ket qua am tinh cung huu ich vi cho thay phuong phap nhay den dau, tranh an tuong sai rang chi phat hien duong tinh moi dang quan tam.

lay mau cong dong giup mo rong do phu, nhung dao tao can giai thich kiem soat nhiem va xu ly an toan. nguoi tham gia can duoc phan hoi ket qua, dong thoi thong nhat ro cach luu va chia se thong tin di truyen.
coastal-upwelling-fisheries-forecast-202:
du bao nuoc troi ven bo cho nghe ca upwelling forecasts connect wind, nutrients and fishing decisions bao cao khi hau dai duong 2024–2025 cho thay he thong du bao bien can ket hop gio, nhiet, oxy va quan trac tai cho; nuoc troi co the tang nang suat nhung cung lam dang nuoc thieu oxy hoac axit hon. coastal upwelling occurs when winds move surface water offshore and colder, nutrient-rich water rises from below. the nutrient supply can support phytoplankton and productive food webs, helping sustain fisheries. but “more nutrients” is not always good news: deep water can also be low in oxygen and high in carbon dioxide, creating stress for organisms in nearshore habitats. nuoc troi ven bo xay ra khi gio day nuoc mat ra khoi va nuoc lanh giau duong chat tu duoi sau dang len. nguon duong chat ho tro thuc vat phu du va luoi thuc an nang suat, duy tri nghe ca. nhung “nhieu duong chat” khong luon la tin tot: nuoc sau cung co the it oxy va nhieu carbon dioxide, gay stress cho sinh vat ven bo. upwelling strength changes with wind direction, season and coastal geography. in some eastern boundary regions, seasonal winds drive predictable productive periods; in others, marine heatwaves or unusual atmospheric patterns alter timing and intensity. annual climate reports in 2024–2025 document changing ocean conditions, but local forecasts need station data and region-specific models rather than a global average. cuong do nuoc troi thay doi theo huong gio, mua va dia hinh bo. o mot so vung ria dai duong phia dong, gio mua tao giai doan nang suat kha du bao duoc; noi khac, song nhiet bien hay mo hinh khi quyen bat thuong lam doi thoi diem va cuong do. bao cao khi hau 2024–2025 ghi nhan dieu kien bien bien doi, nhung du bao dia phuong can so lieu tram va mo hinh rieng, khong chi trung binh toan cau. forecasts combine wind observations, satellite sea-surface temperature, ocean models and local sampling. a sudden temperature drop can indicate upwelling, but it does not reveal nutrient concentration, oxygen or fish abundance by itself. fisheries services can translate outlooks into likely habitat conditions, while reporting uncertainty and updating information as observations arrive. du bao ket hop quan trac gio, nhiet do mat bien ve tinh, mo hinh dai duong va lay mau dia phuong. nhiet do giam dot ngot co the bao hieu nuoc troi nhung khong tu cho biet nong do duong chat, oxy hay so luong ca. dich vu nghe ca co the chuyen du bao thanh dieu kien sinh canh co kha nang xay ra, dong thoi neu bat dinh va cap nhat khi co quan sat moi. timing matters economically. fishers may adjust departure dates, gear or target species when productive zones shift. small boats with limited fuel cannot follow moving fish indefinitely, so a forecast only helps if it reaches them in an accessible format and with sufficient lead time. it should not be framed as a guarantee of catch; market demand, regulations, weather safety and fishing pressure still shape outcomes. thoi diem co y nghia kinh te. ngu dan co the dieu chinh ngay ra khoi, ngu cu hay loai muc tieu khi vung nang suat thay doi. tau nho it nhien lieu khong the duoi theo ca vo han, nen du bao chi huu ich neu den voi ho bang dinh dang de hieu va du som. khong nen xem day la bao dam san luong; nhu cau thi truong, quy dinh, an toan thoi tiet va ap luc khai thac van dinh hinh ket qua. environmental monitoring needs to examine the less visible costs. upwelled low-oxygen water can trigger fish kills or compress habitat; excess nutrients may contribute to harmful algal blooms. sampling oxygen, ph and chlorophyll alongside temperature helps distinguish beneficial productivity from harmful conditions. preparedness plans can set thresholds for shellfish closures, aquaculture alerts or safety advice before impacts become obvious. giam sat moi truong can xem ca chi phi kho thay. nuoc troi thieu oxy co the gay ca chet hoac thu hep sinh canh; duong chat du gop phan tao tao doc. do oxy, ph va chlorophyll cung nhiet giup phan biet nang suat co loi voi dieu kien gay hai. ke hoach chuan bi co the dat nguong dong cua thu hoach nhuyen the, canh bao trai nuoi hay khuyen cao an toan truoc khi tac dong tro nen ro. a useful coastal forecast pairs physical conditions with practical decisions and community feedback. local knowledge helps identify where fish appear, how currents change and which routes are safe. the forecast should be evaluated after each season against catches and ecological observations. that learning loop improves services over time while keeping a clear distinction between a predicted ocean condition and the uncertain response of a fish population.

an effective service should deliver a map and a short explanation through channels fishers already use, such as radio, port notices or mobile messages. advice can include likely water conditions, the confidence level and the next update time. it should be co-designed with crews who know local landmarks and safety constraints. forecast evaluation can compare predicted upwelling with measured temperature, oxygen and catch locations, but catch data need privacy safeguards. when access is fair and feedback is incorporated, the service can improve fishing efficiency while reducing unnecessary trips and fuel use.

a forecast can also support safety by identifying wind and wave conditions that make a trip hazardous. fisheries advice should never encourage crews to enter dangerous water simply because fish may be concentrated there. du bao ven bien huu ich ket hop dieu kien vat ly voi quyet dinh thuc te va phan hoi cong dong. tri thuc dia phuong giup xac dinh ca xuat hien o dau, dong chay doi the nao va tuyen nao an toan. can danh gia du bao sau moi mua qua san luong va quan sat sinh thai. vong hoc hoi nay cai thien dich vu, dong thoi phan biet ro dieu kien bien du bao voi phan ung bat dinh cua quan the ca.

a crop yield can rise while total water use also rises. compare like with like and state the boundary. food quality, nutrition, and economic value may also matter. a single “more crop per drop” number can hide whether water was saved, shifted, or simply counted differently. nang suat nuoc lien he dau ra huu ich voi luong nuoc tieu hao hoac cap vao. voi cay trong, nghien cuu co the bieu thi bang kilogam ngu coc tren met khoi boc thoat hoi, luong nuoc tuoi lay tu nguon hoac tong luong nuoc dau vao. cac mau so nay khong the thay the cho nhau. ruong dung it nuoc tuoi hon van co the tieu thu luong nuoc tuong tu neu mua dong gop nhieu hon; index-based-crop-insurance-risk: bao hiem chi so co the bo sot thiet hai tai tung trang trai index-based crop insurance and basis risk bao hiem chi so tra theo mua, nhiet do hay nang suat khu vuc thay such as rainfall below a threshold or average area yield falling. unlike individual indemnity insurance, it does not require an adjuster to inspect every farm loss. this can reduce transaction costs and speed payment in places with limited insurance infrastructure. but the index is only a proxy for the farmer’s actual loss. a field may suffer severe drought while the weather station records enough rain, or an area average may fall even when one farm performs well. this mismatch is called basis risk. bao hiem cay trong theo chi so chi tra khi chi so do duoc vuot nguong, chang han mua thap hon muc xac dinh hoac nang suat binh quan khu vuc giam. khac bao hiem boi thuong theo ton that ca nhan, loai nay khong can giam dinh vien den tung trang trai. cach lam co the giam chi phi giao dich va tang toc chi tra o noi ha tang bao hiem con han che. tuy nhien, chi so chi la dai dien cho thiet hai thuc cua nong dan. ruong co the han nang trong khi tram thoi tiet ghi du mua, hoac nang suat binh quan vung giam du mot trang trai van tot. sai lech nay goi la rui ro co so. the index must correspond to the hazard that affects the insured crop. rainfall totals may miss timing: a season can receive normal rain overall but lack water during flowering. temperature indices may omit humidity or crop stage. area-yield products need reliable harvest statistics and a representative geographic unit. satellite vegetation indices can help where gauges are sparse, but cloud cover, crop mixtures, and resolution affect estimates. product design involves a trade-off between simple rules and local accuracy. a very small area may improve fit but raise costs; a large area reduces costs yet can make the index less representative. chi so can phan anh hiem hoa anh huong cay duoc bao hiem. tong luong mua co the bo lo thoi diem: ca mua du mua nhung thieu nuoc luc ra hoa. chi so nhiet do co the khong tinh do am hay giai doan cay. san pham theo nang suat khu vuc can thong ke thu hoach dang tin va don vi dia ly dai dien. chi so thuc vat ve tinh ho tro noi it tram do, nhung may, hon hop cay va do phan giai anh huong uoc tinh. thiet ke san pham phai danh doi giua quy tac don gian va do chinh xac dia phuong. khu vuc nho co the khop hon nhung ton chi phi; khu vuc lon giam chi phi nhung chi so kem dai dien. trigger design determines how much protection is offered and when. a farmer needs to understand the deductible, coverage level, payout formula, and whether payment is capped. historical data can test how often the index would have paid compared with simulated farm losses. if farmers policy for index data. a forecast is not necessarily an insurance index, and a trigger should not be confused with a guarantee of full compensation. thiet ke nguong quyet dinh muc bao ve va thoi diem chi tra. nong dan can hieu khoan khau tru, muc bao hiem, cong thuc thanh toan va gioi han chi tra. du lieu lich su co the kiem tra tan suat chi so se kich hoat so voi ton that mo phong tai trang trai. lieu chi so. du bao thoi tiet khong nhat thiet la chi so bao hiem; nguong kich hoat cung khong phai cam ket boi thuong toan bo. insurance transfers part of financial risk but does not prevent crop pesticide-spray-drift-reduction: giam troi dat thuoc bao ve thuc vat can tuan nhan va dieu kien gio reducing pesticide spray drift protects nearby areas giot thuoc co the roi vung phun do gio, kich thuoc giot, chieu cao voi va thiet bi. cong cu palm cua epa ra mat nam 2025 giup doc yeu cau giam thieu, nhung nhan san pham va quy dinh dia phuong van chi phoi. spray drift occurs when pesticide droplets or vapor move away from the intended application area. drift can expose nearby people, crops, pollinators, water, or wildlife. droplet size matters: fine droplets are more easily carried by wind, while larger droplets may reduce drift but can affect coverage. nozzle type, pressure, boom height, aircraft speed, wind, temperature inversions, and field edges all influence movement. the product label contains enforceable directions for application. reducing drift is both a safety and stewardship task; a farmer should never rely on a generic rule that overrides the specific label. troi dat thuoc xay ra khi giot hoac hoi thuoc bao ve thuc vat di chuyen khoi vung dinh phun. no co the phoi nhiem nguoi gan do, cay trong, loai thu phan, nuoc hay dong vat hoang da. kich thuoc giot quan trong: giot min de bi gio cuon hon, giot lon co the giam troi nhung anh huong do phu. loai voi, ap suat, chieu cao can phun, toc do may bay, gio, nghich nhiet va ria ruong deu anh huong huong di. nhan san pham co chi dan bat buoc ve su dung. giam troi vua la van de an toan vua la trach nhiem quan ly; nong dan khong nen dua vao quy tac chung de thay chi dan rieng tren nhan. weather checks should happen at the application site and continue during spraying. wind speed and direction can change over a short distance, especially near tree lines or buildings. temperature inversions can hold fine droplets near the ground and move them laterally. rain may wash a product off before it works, while high heat can alter evaporation. labels may specify wind limits, buffer zones, droplet class, or restrictions for sensitive crops. record time, conditions, equipment, and product used. if conditions move outside the label, stop the application and wait rather than trying to compensate by changing another setting. kiem tra thoi tiet can thuc hien tai noi phun va tiep tuc trong suot qua trinh. toc do, huong gio co the doi trong khoang cach ngan, nhat la gan hang cay hay cong trinh. nghich nhiet co the giu giot min gan mat dat roi day ngang. mua co the rua thuoc truoc khi phat huy tac dung, con nong cao lam thay doi bay hoi. nhan co the neu gioi han gio, vung dem, cap kich thuoc giot hay han che voi cay nhay cam. ghi thoi gian, dieu kien, thiet bi va san pham. neu dieu kien vuot ngoai nhan, hay dung va cho thay vi co bu bang cach doi thong so khac. buffers protect areas downwind or next to a field. a buffer may be a no-spray distance, a vegetated strip, or an area managed according to label conditions. buffer requirements differ by active ingredient, crop, application method, and ecological risk. epa’s mitigation menu links certain label options to reductions in spray drift or runoff risk. in august 2025, epa released palm, a mobile-friendly app to help applicators use the mitigation menu for agricultural crop labels. the tool assists with interpretation; growth, and harvest activities across a season. it helps coordinate seed purchases, labor, irrigation, machinery, and market delivery. traditional calendars may be based on local rainfall patterns, temperature, and farmer experience. climate variability can shift the onset of rains, increase dry spells, or change the timing of heat during flowering. a calendar is therefore a planning aid, not a lieu phan tach co the cho thay mot chinh sach cai thien trai nghiem cua nhom nay nhung bo lai nhom khac. employers can use a job-quality review before changing a process. ask whether staffing levels what prevents a suitable match? bao cao eures 2025 so sanh nghe thieu nhan luc voi nghe du thua thay vi xem tung nghe biet lap. dieu do quan trong vi lao dong co the san o vung hoac nghe nay trong khi pay-transparency-eu-2026: minh bach tien luong: cong cu thu hep khoang cach, khong phai phep mau pay transparency: a tool, not a complete cure chi thi eu 2023/970 dat yeu cau minh bach tra luong va information before hiring, access to criteria used to determine pay and reporting on gender pay gaps. the eu pay transparency directive, adopted in 2023, set a 7 june 2026 deadline for member states to transpose its rules into national law. as of that date, implementation may differ by country, so a directive’s text should not be confused with a uniform new process already operating everywhere. the policy responds to a practical information problem: applicants often negotiate without knowing the range or how comparable roles are paid. minh bach tien luong nghia la lam ro mot phan quy trinh xac dinh luong cua doanh nghiep voi nguoi lao dong va ung vien. noi dung co the gom thong tin luong truoc tuyen dung, quyen tiep can tieu chi tra luong va bao cao chenh lech luong gioi. chi thi minh tuong duong. imagine two candidates applying for similar analyst roles. one knows the employer’s salary band; the other is asked for a previous salary and guesses a lower figure. the initial information gap can shape later offers even when both people have comparable skills. publishing a range can make expectations clearer and reduce the influence of salary history, but it does not guarantee equal pay. a broad band with no explanation may provide little useful information. employers also need objective criteria—such as skills, responsibility and relevant experience—and a consistent method to evaluate them. transparency helps reveal a pay system; it cannot by itself make that system fair. hay hinh dung hai ung vien nop don vao vi tri phan tich tuong tu. mot nguoi biet dinh; tan suat va nguong thay doi theo quy mo. day la quy dinh cap eu, hieu qua thuc te phu thuoc chuyen hoa luat quoc gia, thuc thi va thu tuc de tiep can. nguoi lao dong nen hoi co quan lao dong hoac tra cuu luat nuoc so tai. so sanh dua tren cong viec co gia tri ngang nhau chu khong nhat thiet chuc danh giong het, nen can danh gia co can cu ve cong viec thuc hien. for an organisation, a pay changes or sector shocks. stronger evaluation checks what happened to similar workers or firms that were less affected, while stating assumptions and uncertainty. outcomes can differ across groups: formal employees may receive a direct raise, while informal workers may remain outside enforcement. small firms may adjust through prices, productivity, staffing or margins. the point is not to assume one universal effect; it is to measure the channels and identify who gains, who bears costs and under what conditions. nha hoach dinh chinh sach dung truoc hai cau hoi chinh dang: muc san co cai thien muc song khong, va no anh huong viec lam, gio cong hoac chi phi doanh nghiep the nao? so sanh don gian truoc va sau co the nham tac dong chinh sach voi lam phat, thay doi nhu cau hoac cu soc nganh. danh gia tot hon kiem tra ket qua cua nhom lao dong hoac doanh nghiep tuong tu nhung it chiu tac dong, dong thoi neu gia dinh va bat dinh. ket qua khac nhau theo nhom: lao dong chinh thuc co the duoc tang luong truc tiep, con nguoi lam phi chinh thuc nam ngoai thuc thi. doanh nghiep nho co the dieu chinh gia, nang suat, nhan su hoac loi nhuan. khong nen mac dinh tac dong pho quat; can do cac kenh va xac dinh ai duoc loi, ai ganh chi phi, trong dieu kien nao. a wage floor is usually more effective when it is predictable and updated through a credible process. viet nam’s system uses regional employment, inflation and firms’ ability to comply all matter. the ilo’s 2026 study calls attention to collective bargaining and social dialogue as part of a broader wage-setting system. consultation helps surface evidence from workers, employers and government, although it does not remove disagreement. publishing the reasoning behind an adjustment makes the decision easier to assess later. muc tinh muc phu hop tu mot chi so: nhu cau cua lao dong va gia dinh, nang suat, viec lam, lam phat va kha nang tuan thu cua doanh nghiep deu quan trong. nghien cuu ilo nam 2026 chu y den thuong luong tap nang; thiet ke dao tao can ha rao can thuc te. adult learning is often presented as an individual choice: workers should keep their skills current. but participation also depends on who can afford tuition, find time, receive useful information and obtain employer support. the oecd skills outlook 2025 finds unequal access to training that builds transferable or high-value skills. adults whose parents had tertiary qualifications are more likely to take courses in project management, numeracy and languages; others more often receive job-specific or compliance training. this pattern matters because broad skills can support mobility across occupations, while narrow training may help only in one current role. the report calls attention to access, not just enrolment totals. hoc tap o tuoi truong thanh thuong duoc trinh bay nhu lua chon ca nhan: nguoi lao dong nen lien tuc cap nhat ky nang. nhung su tham gia con phu thuoc kha nang tra hoc phi, sap xep thoi gian, tiep nhan thong tin huu ich va duoc chu lao dong ho tro. oecd skills outlook 2025 ghi nhan co hoi dao tao ky nang chuyen doi hoac gia tri cao phan bo khong deu. nguoi co cha me tot nghiep dai hoc de tham gia khoa quan ly du an, tinh toan va ngoai ngu hon; nhom khac thuong nhan dao tao chuyen biet hoac tuan thu. dieu nay quan trong vi ky nang rong co the giup chuyen nghe, con dao tao hep co the chi huu ich trong vai tro hien tai. bao cao chu y den kha nang tiep can, khong chi tong so nguoi ghi danh. time can be the decisive barrier. a parent working shifts may technically qualify for an evening course but lack childcare or predictable hours. a self-employed worker may have no paid leave and lose income by attending. a low-wage employee may not know which course is recognised by employers. these obstacles are not solved by placing course material online; connectivity, disability access, language, confidence and time still matter. training policy should ask whether the intended learner can complete the programme without taking on unmanageable costs. flexible scheduling, paid learning hours, childcare support and clear information can convert nominal availability into real access. thoi gian co the la rao can quyet dinh. mot phu huynh lam ca co the du dieu kien hoc buoi toi nhung thieu nguoi trong tre hoac lich on dinh. nguoi tu doanh co the khong co nghi phep huong luong va mat thu nhap khi tham du. nhan vien luong thap co the khong biet khoa nao duoc nha tuyen dung cong nhan. dua tai lieu len mang khong tu giai quyet cac tro ngai: ket noi, kha nang tiep can voi nguoi khuyet tat, ngon ngu, su tu tin va thoi gian van quan trong. chinh sach dao tao nen hoi nguoi hoc muc tieu co the hoan tat chuong trinh ma khong chiu chi phi qua suc hay khong. lich linh hoat, gio hoc duoc tra luong, ho tro trong tre va thong tin ro co the bien co hoi danh nghia thanh kha nang tiep can that. good training begins with a labour-market need but also respects what learners want to do. an employer can assess competence through demonstrated work. public employment services can guide learners toward courses with credible outcomes, while transparent data should show completion, job transitions and wages rather than only attendance. dao tao tot bat dau tu nhu cau thi truong lao dong nhung cung ton trong mong muon cua nguoi hoc. nha tuyen dung co the xac dinh thieu ky nang van hanh may moi, trong cong co the huong hoc vien den khoa co ket qua dang tin, con du lieu minh bach can cho thay ty le hoan tat, chuyen viec va luong thay vi chi so luot tham du. employers have a role because they control workers and firms with barriers, but should include quality checks to avoid paying for programmes that lead nowhere. worker consultation also helps prevent courses from being chosen solely for constraints, a small modular course may be a realistic first step, provided it connects to a larger progression route rather than ending in a dead end. nguoi hoc co the lap ke hoach thuc te bang cach so chi phi, thoi luong, cach danh gia va muc cong nhan cua khoa hoc. hay hoi chung chi duoc cong nhan ngoai mot doanh nghiep khong, khoa co thuc hanh duoc giam sat khong va ho tro ra sao neu bo lo platform-work-convention-193-2026: tieu chuan lao dong quoc te moi cho kinh te nen tang a new international labour standard for platform work ilo thong qua cong uoc 193 nam 2026; day la chuan muc quoc te moi, nhung nghia vu thuc te con phu thuoc phe chuan quoc gia. digital labour platforms connect clients with people who perform tasks, from local deliveries to remote translation. a key difficulty is that legal protections can depend on whether a person is classified as an employee, self-employed or another status. the ilo adopted convention no. 193 on decent work in the platform economy in june 2026, the first international labour standard specifically dedicated to this area. its adoption signals agreement on the need for protections, but it does not automatically make every rule enforceable in every country. states must follow their constitutional ratification processes, and national laws determine how obligations apply in practice. nen tang lao dong so ket noi khach hang voi nguoi thuc hien nhiem vu, tu giao hang noi do den dich thuat tu xa. kho khan cot loi la bao ve phap ly co the phu thuoc vao viec mot nguoi duoc xep la nhan vien, tu doanh hay dang khac. ilo thong qua cong uoc so 193 ve viec lam thoa dang trong kinh te nen tang vao thang 6/2026, tieu chuan lao dong quoc te dau tien danh rieng cho linh vuc nay. viec thong qua cho thay dong thuan ve nhu cau bao ve, nhung khong tu dong khien moi quy tac co hieu luc o moi quoc gia. cac nuoc phai thuc hien quy trinh phe chuan theo hien phap, con luat quoc gia quy dinh nghia vu ap dung trong thuc te. platform work varies widely. a courier may depend on an app that allocates jobs and tracks routes, while a remote designer bids for projects and negotiates directly with clients. income can be flexible but unstable; workers may lack paid leave, insurance or a clear appeals process. some people value the ability to choose hours, while others face opaque ratings or sudden account suspension. regulation therefore has to address both the platform’s control and the worker’s actual independence. a label in a contract is not enough to settle status if real practice shows instructions, monitoring and economic dependence. the standard-setting debate reflects this diverse work rather than assuming every platform job is identical. cong viec nen tang rat da dang. nguoi giao hang co the phu thuoc ung dung phan nhiem vu va theo doi tuyen duong, con nha thiet ke tu xa dau thau du an va thuong luong truc tiep voi khach hang. thu nhap linh hoat nhung thieu on dinh; nguoi lao dong co the khong co nghi phep huong luong, bao hiem hoac quy trinh khieu nai ro. mot so nguoi thich tu chon gio, so khac phai chiu xep hang mo duc hoac tai khoan bi khoa dot ngot. vi vay, quy dinh can xem ca muc do kiem soat cua nen tang lan tinh doc lap thuc te. nhan trong hop dong khong du xac dinh tinh trang neu thuc te co chi dao, giam sat va phu thuoc kinh te. tranh luan thiet lap tieu chuan phan anh su da dang ay, khong gia dinh moi viec nen tang giong nhau. international labour standards usually create obligations for governments that ratify them, not immediate direct rules for every private company. a convention can guide national legislation, labour inspection and social dialogue; its practical reach depends on ratification and implementation. workers should therefore distinguish adoption at the international labour conference from entry into force for a particular country. the ilo’s june 2026 explanation of convention 193 describes it as a framework for decent work, including rights and protection in the platform economy. the text should be read alongside existing national law and other standards. until a country ratifies and implements relevant provisions, legal claims must rest on rules already applicable there. cac tieu chuan lao dong quoc te thuong tao nghia vu cho chinh phu phe chuan, khong lap tuc ap quy tac truc tiep len moi doanh nghiep tu nhan. cong uoc co the dinh huong luat quoc gia, thanh tra lao dong va doi thoai xa hoi; pham vi thuc te phu thuoc phe chuan va trien khai. vi vay, nguoi lao dong can phan biet viec thong qua tai hoi nghi lao dong quoc te voi ngay co hieu luc tai quoc gia minh. ban giai thich cong uoc 193 cua ilo thang 6/2026 mo ta day la khuon kho cho viec lam thoa dang, gom quyen va bao ve trong kinh te nen tang. can doc van ban cung luat quoc gia va tieu chuan hien hanh. truoc khi nuoc phe chuan va trien khai dieu khoan lien quan, yeu cau phap ly phai dua tren quy dinh dang ap dung. for platform workers, a practical record can help clarify what the relationship looks like: who sets prices, assigns work, imposes performance rules, sees location data, controls customer access and can suspend an account. keep copies of terms, payment records, task histories and messages, while protecting clients’ personal information. if a decision seems wrong, use the available review route and seek advice from a local labour authority or worker organization. this is not a substitute for legal counsel; classifications differ by jurisdiction. such documentation helps show the difference between genuine business autonomy and dependence shaped by the platform’s rules. it may also help regulators understand how a system operates beyond the contract’s wording. voi nguoi lam nen tang, luu ho so thuc te co the giup lam ro quan he: ai dat gia, giao viec, ap quy tac hieu suat, xem du lieu vi tri, kiem soat quyen tiep can khach hang va co the khoa tai khoan. hay giu ban dieu khoan, lich su thanh toan, nhiem vu va tin nhan, dong thoi bao ve du lieu ca nhan khach hang. neu cho rang quyet dinh sai, hay dung kenh ra soat hien co va hoi co quan lao dong hoac to chuc nguoi lao dong tai dia phuong. day khong thay the tu van phap ly; phan loai khac nhau theo khu vuc phap quyen. tai lieu giup cho thay khac biet giua tu chu kinh doanh that voi su phu thuoc do quy tac nen tang tao ra. no cung giup co quan quan ly hieu he thong van hanh vuot ra ngoai cau chu hop dong. platforms can design stronger safeguards even before a new national law takes effect. publish how ratings affect access to work, explain account restrictions, provide human review for serious decisions and give workers reasonable notice of material changes. data minimisation can limit unnecessary tracking; worker consultation can surface errors that managers overlook. these practices do not decide employment status by themselves, and a polished appeals screen cannot replace legal rights. they can, however, reduce avoidable harm and create useful records. a platform that uses automated allocation should disclose meaningful information about the rules, keep a route for correction, and test whether the system produces unfair results for particular groups. nen tang co the thiet ke bien phap bao ve tot hon truoc khi luat quoc gia moi co hieu luc. cong bo xep hang anh huong quyen nhan viec ra sao, giai thich han che tai khoan, co nguoi ra soat quyet dinh nghiem trong va bao truoc hop ly khi doi dieu khoan. giam thieu du lieu giup han che theo doi khong can thiet; tham van nguoi lao dong co the phat hien loi quan ly bo qua. nhung cach lam nay tu chung khong xac dinh tinh trang nhan vien, va giao dien khieu nai dep khong thay quyen phap ly. tuy nhien, chung giam tac hai co the tranh va tao ho so huu ich. nen tang dung tu dong phan viec nen cong bo thong tin co y nghia ve quy tac, duy tri kenh sua loi va kiem tra he thong co tao ket qua bat cong cho nhom nao khong. the new convention is a starting point for a longer process. governments, employers, workers and platforms will debate ratification, implementation and how to protect people without ignoring genuine flexibility. monitor the status in the relevant country rather than assuming the 2026 adoption has changed every contract. compare legal rules with practical features of work: who controls the task, who bears commercial risk, what protections exist and whether workers can challenge decisions. the durable lesson is that decent-work standards must keep pace with new business models, while rights should not depend only on a platform’s self-selected label. evidence and local law determine the next step. cong uoc moi mo dau cho quy trinh dai hon. chinh phu, doanh nghiep, nguoi lao dong va nen tang se tiep tuc tranh luan ve phe chuan, thuc thi va cach bao ve con nguoi ma khong bo qua tinh linh hoat that su. hay theo doi tinh trang tai quoc gia lien quan thay vi cho rang viec thong qua nam 2026 da thay doi moi hop dong. so quy tac phap ly voi dac diem cong viec thuc te: ai kiem soat nhiem vu, ai ganh rui ro kinh doanh, co bao ve nao va nguoi lao dong co the khieu nai quyet dinh khong. bai hoc ben vung la tieu chuan viec lam thoa dang phai theo kip mo hinh kinh doanh moi, con quyen loi khong nen chi phu thuoc nhan ma nen tang tu chon. bang chung va luat dia phuong quyet dinh buoc tiep theo.

applicants can use assistive technology, and whether the model was tested after software or job requirements changed. bai kiem tra thuc te bat dau bang nhiem vu ro rang. neu cong ty muon tuyen nhan mat trong du lieu huan luyen, ung vien co dung cong nghe ho tro khong va mo hinh da duoc kiem tra lai sau khi phan mem hoac yeu cau viec lam thay doi chua. applicants should receive understandable and the skills people need. the oecd skills outlook 2025 notes evidence that negotiated adoption, worker consultation and training—including dedicated learning time—are associated with better outcomes change. dua ai vao cong viec la thay doi to chuc chu khong chi mua phan mem. no co the lam doi phan cong nhiem vu, khoi luong viec, danh gia hieu suat va ky nang can thiet. oecd skills outlook 2025 equivalent to meaningful involvement if budgets, targets and staffing are already fixed. early consultation does not give every worker a veto, but it makes trade-offs visible and allows a redesign while options remain open. tham van nen dien ra truoc quyet dinh kho dao nguoc. nhom co the lap so do quy trinh hien tai, xac dinh buoc lap lai, ghi nhan truong hop can phan doan cua nguoi va mo ta participation-barriers-eu-2025: tang tham gia lao dong can thao go rao can cu the raising participation means removing specific barriers bao cao uy ban chau au nam 2025 uoc tinh 51 trieu cu dan eu tu 20–64 tuoi o ngoai luc luong lao dong. a country can report many job vacancies while millions of working-age residents remain outside employment. the european commission’s 2025 employment and social developments in europe report analysed 51 million eu residents aged 20–64 who were outside the workforce. this group includes people with different circumstances: some study, provide care, manage a health condition, retire early or have stopped searching. they are not one homogeneous pool of available labour. the report argues that increasing participation alongside reducing unemployment and underemployment is relevant to labour supply. the figure is an eu snapshot for a defined age band, not a count of people who could all begin work immediately. mot quoc gia co the bao nhieu vi tri tuyen dung trong khi hang trieu cu dan tuoi lao dong van ngoai viec lam. bao cao employment and social developments in europe nam 2025 cua uy ban chau au phan tich 51 trieu cu dan eu tu 20–64 tuoi ngoai luc luong lao dong. nhom gom nguoi co hoan canh khac nhau: mot so dang hoc, cham soc gia dinh, xu ly tinh trang suc khoe, nghi huu som hoac da ngung tim viec. day khong phai mot nguon lao dong dong nhat san sang di lam. bao cao cho rang tang tham gia cung giam that nghiep va thieu viec lam co y nghia voi nguon cung lao dong. con so la anh chup eu theo nhom tuoi xac dinh, khong phai so nguoi deu co the bat dau lam ngay. barriers differ. a parent may want paid work but lack affordable childcare; they require distinguishing essential functions from customary requirements. a transparent job analysis can identify what must be done and which methods are flexible. trial periods and supported onboarding can help assess fit without imposing excessive risk on either side. nha tuyen dung co the mo rong tiep can bang cach ra mo ta viec va tuyen dung. bang dai hoc co that su can thiet hay co the nhan ky nang da kiem chung? co the chia vai tro, xep ca de doan hoac dieu chinh hop ly khong? phong van co tiep can duoc va ung vien biet khoang luong chua? thay doi nay giup cham den nguoi tung bi loai som. chung khong doi giam tieu chuan chat luong; self-employment-job-quality-europe-2025: tu doanh co tu chu hon nhung cung di kem rui ro self-employment: autonomy with uneven risks nghien cuu oecd cong bo nam 2025 cho thay tu doanh doc lap o chau au co the ket hop tu chu cao hon voi suc ep thoi gian va dieu kien an toan kem. self-employment is not one uniform work arrangement. a business owner with employees may control products and schedules, while a solo worker may depend on a few clients and face irregular income. the oecd’s 2025 analysis of job quality in european self-employment uses survey data from 1995 to 2021. it finds that solo self-employed people tend to face poorer conditions than self-employed people with employees. across the period, autonomy and social-environment measures improved, while health and safety conditions deteriorated and time pressure increased. the publication date is recent, but the underlying observation window ends in 2021, so it should not be described as a 2025 measurement. tu doanh khong phai mot hinh thuc lam viec dong nhat. chu doanh nghiep co nhan vien co the kiem soat san pham va lich, con nguoi lam mot minh phu thuoc vai khach hang va thu nhap that thuong. phan tich oecd cong bo nam 2025 ve chat luong viec lam tu doanh tai chau au su dung khao sat giai doan 1995–2021. nghien cuu cho thay nguoi tu doanh don le thuong gap dieu kien kem hon nguoi tu doanh co nhan vien. trong giai doan do, chi so tu chu va moi truong xa hoi cai thien, con an toan suc khoe giam va ap luc thoi gian tang. ngay xuat ban gan day nhung khoang quan sat ket thuc nam 2021; flexibility can help with care yet make workers available at all hours; independence can reduce supervision but leave safety training to the individual. the oecd findings suggest that solo self-employment deserves specific attention rather than being grouped with small-business owners who hire staff. researchers can compare earnings stability, working time, autonomy, social support, health risks and progression. survey evidence captures experience but may underrepresent people in precarious or informal arrangements. combining surveys with tax, business and safety data can improve the picture, while respecting privacy and differences in legal classification. chat luong viec lam can duoc danh gia qua nhieu chieu. thu nhap trung binh co the cao nhung dao dong tung thang; linh hoat giup cham soc gia dinh nhung cung khien nguoi lao dong luon phai san sang; doc lap giam giam sat nhung de ca nhan tu lo dao tao an toan. ket qua oecd goi y can chu y rieng nguoi tu doanh don le thay vi gop voi chu doanh nghiep nho thue nhan vien. nha nghien cuu co the so on dinh thu nhap, gio lam, quyen tu chu, ho tro xa hoi, rui ro suc khoe va co hoi phat trien. khao sat nam trai nghiem nhung co the bo sot nhom bap benh hoac phi chinh thuc. ket hop khao sat voi du lieu thue, doanh nghiep va an toan giup buc tranh tot hon, dong thoi phai bao ve rieng tu va khac biet phan loai phap ly. a solo worker can manage risk by using written scopes, milestone payments and clear cancellation terms, but these measures do not eliminate client concentration or an industry downturn. record business expenses, set aside money for tax and social contributions where required, and make a plan for illness or time off. this is general risk management, not personalised financial advice. professional associations or cooperatives can share information, training and sometimes insurance options. public policy can improve access to social protection for self-employed people and clarify status where platform control resembles employment. the best approach depends on national rules; chua co quyet dinh phat hanh. a digital euro would be a digital form of central-bank money for everyday payments, complementing cash and private bank deposits. it is not simply a banking-app balance: a bank deposit is a claim on a commercial bank, whereas central-bank money is a direct liability of the central bank. in 2026, the project remains in preparation while eu lawmakers discuss the legal framework. the european parliament adopted its position in july 2026, after the council agreed its position in december 2025; no khong co nghia cong chung da su dung duoc euro so hoac moi cau hoi ky thuat va chinh sach da duoc giai quyet. a retail digital euro could support payments in shops and online, including situations where a user wants to pay without relying on a commercial bank account in the same way as today. the design must preserve the role of supervised payment providers and avoid destabilising bank funding. if households moved a large share of deposits into central-bank money during stress, banks might lose a stable source of funding more quickly. policymakers therefore discuss holding limits, conversion mechanisms and an intermediary model. a limit could reduce run risk but also constrain usefulness. such trade-offs are design questions; ket noi ha tang quyet toan ban buon de thu nghiem thanh toan hai dong tien dong bo. a foreign-exchange transaction exchanges one currency for another. the two sides may send funds through different payment systems, and if one side pays while the other fails, a party can lose the principal amount. payment-versus-payment, or pvp, links the two currency transfers so that one settles if and only if the other settles. the bis innovation hub’s project meridian fx tested synchronised settlement across wholesale payment infrastructures. in its april 2025 report, bis said the project demonstrated technical feasibility of interoperability between systems such as real-time gross settlement platforms for fx transactions. it was an experiment, not a universal mechanism already available to every market participant. giao dich ngoai hoi trao doi tien te nay lay tien te khac. hai ben co the chuyen tien qua he thong thanh toan khac nhau; neu mot ben tra con ben kia that bai, mot ben co the mat khoan goc. thanh toan doi ung (pvp) lien ket hai luong tien de mot ben chi quyet toan neu va chi neu ben kia cung quyet toan. project meridian fx cua trung tam doi moi bis thu nghiem quyet toan dong bo giua ha tang thanh toan ban buon. trong bao cao thang 4/2025, bis cho biet du an chung minh kha thi ky thuat khi tuong tac giua he thong nhu nen tang quyet toan gop thoi gian thuc cho giao dich ngoai hoi. day la thu nghiem, khong phai co che pho quat moi thanh vien thi truong deu su dung. time-zone differences make fx settlement complex. a payment system in one country may be closed while the other remains open, leaving one party exposed for hours. a synchronisation operator can coordinate both legs and monitor whether required funds are available. if a condition fails, the process should avoid completing only one side. pvp can reduce principal settlement risk, but it does not eliminate market risk, liquidity risk or operational risk. participants still need sufficient balances in both currencies and robust rules for delayed or failed messages. the design also needs legal clarity on when the payment becomes final. khac biet mui gio lam quyet toan ngoai hoi phuc tap. he thong thanh toan o mot nuoc co the dong trong khi ben kia mo, khien mot ben phoi nhiem rui ro nhieu gio. don vi dong bo hoa co the dieu phoi hai chan giao dich va theo doi tien co san khong. neu dieu kien that bai, quy trinh can tranh hoan tat mot phia. pvp giam rui ro quyet toan khoan goc nhung khong xoa rui ro thi truong, thanh khoan hay van hanh. thanh vien van can du so du o ca hai dong tien va quy truong da co nen tang quyet toan dang tin. co che dong bo dieu phoi lenh qua cac he thong trong khi moi dong tien van quyet toan noi dia. thanh vien can ma dinh danh chung, chuan thong diep va cach token thanh toan giam viec lo so the that nhung can quan ly dung. when a cardholder pays online, the merchant or payment service may need a credential that identifies the funding account. payment tokenisation substitutes a token for the underlying card number, often limiting where and how that token can be used. emvco maintains specifications for interoperable payment tokenisation. in july 2026, it published version 2.4 of the technical framework. a token is not the same thing as a cryptocurrency or a claim on a distributed ledger; in this setting it is a substitute credential managed within a payment ecosystem. the security benefit comes from controls around issuance, domain restriction and lifecycle management, not from the word “token” alone. khi chu the thanh toan truc tuyen, thuong nhan hoac dich vu thanh toan co the can thong tin xac dinh tai khoan nguon tien. token hoa thanh toan thay so the nen bang token, thuong gioi han noi va cach token duoc dung. emvco duy tri dac ta de token hoa thanh toan tuong tac duoc. thang 7/2026, to chuc cong bo phien ban 2.4 cua khung ky thuat. token o day khong giong tien ma hoa hay quyen doi tren so cai phan tan; no la thong tin xac thuc thay the duoc quan ly trong he sinh thai thanh toan. loi ich an ninh den tu kiem soat phat hanh, gioi han mien va quan ly vong doi, khong chi tu chu “token”. a merchant might receive a token that works only for a particular merchant, device or transaction context. if the token is stolen from that environment, its usefulness to an attacker can be narrower than a reusable card number. payment networks or token service providers can map the substitute value back to the funding account when an authorised transaction arrives. the original card number need not travel through every system that handles the purchase. this reduces the number of places where a raw credential is exposed. however, tokenisation does not eliminate fraud: malware, account takeover, social engineering and weak merchant controls can still compromise a payment. thuong nhan co the nhan token chi hoat dong voi thuong nhan, thiet bi hoac ngu canh giao dich cu the. neu token bi lay tu moi truong do, tinh huu dung voi ke tan cong co the hep hon so the dung lai nhieu noi. mang thanh toan hoac nha cung cap dich vu token co the anh xa gia tri thay the ve tai khoan nguon khi nhan giao dich duoc cap phep. so the goc khong can di qua moi he thong xu ly mua hang. dieu nay giam so noi lo thong tin xac thuc tho. tuy nhien token hoa khong xoa gian lan: ma doc, chiem tai khoan, thao tung xa hoi va kiem soat thuong nhan yeu van co the lam lo thanh toan. lifecycle management is essential. a token may be provisioned to a digital wallet, suspended when a device is lost, replaced when a card expires or deleted when a customer removes the card. the payment system needs to authenticate the request, verify the token’s domain and check whether the token remains active. merchants must not treat every token as universally portable. a token scoped to one device may fail on another; this can be a deliberate security boundary rather than a technical defect. customer support should explain how to update a wallet or revoke access without exposing the underlying card number. quan ly vong doi rat thiet yeu. token co the duoc cap vao vi so, tam khoa khi mat thiet bi, thay khi the het han hoac xoa khi khach go the. he thong thanh toan can xac thuc yeu cau, kiem tra mien token va xem token con hoat dong khong. thuong nhan khong nen coi moi token co the dung moi noi. token gioi han cho mot thiet bi co the that bai tren may khac; do co the la ranh gioi an toan co chu y chu khong phai loi. ho tro khach can giai thich cach cap nhat vi hoac thu hoi quyen ma khong lam lo so the goc. tokenisation works alongside other controls. strong customer authentication can verify that the cardholder initiated a remote purchase; device security protects the wallet; transaction monitoring can identify unusual patterns; and clear dispute procedures help resolve unauthorised charges. a token does not prove that a buyer intended a purchase or that a merchant delivered a product. nor does it guarantee privacy: transaction details may still be visible to issuers, payment providers and merchants according to their roles and law. data minimisation and retention rules remain relevant. security is layered, so no single credential technology should be described as a complete fraud-prevention solution. token hoa hoat dong cung bien phap khac. xac thuc manh co the xac minh chu the khoi tao mua tu xa; an ninh thiet bi bao ve vi; giam sat giao dich nhan dien mo hinh bat thuong; thu tuc tranh chap ro giup giai quyet khoan tru trai phep. token khong chung minh nguoi mua dinh mua hay thuong nhan da giao hang. no cung khong bao dam quyen rieng tu: chi tiet giao dich van co the hien voi to chuc phat hanh, nha cung cap thanh toan va thuong nhan theo vai tro va luat. giam thieu du lieu va thoi han luu van lien quan. an ninh co nhieu lop nen khong nen mo ta mot cong nghe thong tin xac thuc nhu giai phap chong gian lan toan dien. for a merchant or fintech, implementation requires agreement on who issues tokens, who manages the mapping service, how credentials are updated and how failures are reported. systems must handle both token and account lifecycle events, including a reissued card or a customer who changes devices. logging should support investigation while limiting access to sensitive records. test token provisioning, revocation, refunds, recurring payments and cross-device behaviour. if a token expires but a subscription continues, both the customer and merchant need a transparent way to resolve the interruption. interoperability is valuable when it preserves security boundaries across wallets, issuers and payment processors. voi thuong nhan hoac fintech, trien khai can thong nhat ai phat hanh token, ai quan ly dich vu anh xa, thong tin xac thuc cap nhat ra sao va bao loi the nao. he thong xu ly ca vong doi token lan tai khoan, gom the duoc cap lai hoac khach doi thiet bi. nhat ky ho tro dieu tra nhung phai han che truy cap ho so nhay cam. kiem thu cap token, thu hoi, hoan tien, thanh toan dinh ky va dung giua cac thiet bi. neu token het han trong khi thue bao con hoat dong, khach va thuong nhan can cach minh bach xu ly gian doan. tuong tac huu ich khi duy tri ranh gioi an ninh giua vi, to chuc phat hanh va don vi xu ly. emvco’s 2026 version update is a technical standards milestone; a minority become high-growth firms. those scalers can contribute significantly to productivity and employment, yet their emergence depends on access to customers, finance, skilled staff and dependable infrastructure. policies that subsidise every entrant may waste resources, while policies that favour established firms can block experimentation. a stronger approach improves the conditions for entry and growth, uses transparent eligibility rules, and evaluates support by additional outcomes. data should distinguish jobs created by start-ups from job gains at older firms that are expanding. viec doanh nghiep roi thi truong la van de nhay cam va khong the tu dong xem la that bai chinh sach. cong ty co the dong cua vi chu nghi huu, san pham loi thoi hay nhu cau doi huong. quy dinh pha san anh huong kha nang tai co cau, ban tai san hoac rut lui trat tu ma khong bi tri hoan qua muc. neu rut lui qua ton kem, von va lao dong co the mac ket trong hoat dong yeu kem. neu thanh ly dien ra qua nhanh hoac quyen cua chu no khong ro, doanh nghiep co kha nang hoi phuc co the mat co hoi vay von. the che tot cho phep khoi dau lai thuc su, dong thoi ngan gian lan va bao ve quyen loi hop phap. muc tieu khong phai toi da so vu dong cua, ma la de nguon luc dich chuyen cong bang. exit is sensitive and should not be treated as a policy failure by itself. a firm may close after an owner retires, a product becomes obsolete or demand shifts. insolvency rules influence whether a business can restructure, sell assets or make an orderly exit without excessive delay. if exit is too costly, capital and workers can remain tied to weak activities. if liquidation is too rapid or creditor protections are unclear, viable businesses may lose access to finance. effective institutions allow a genuine second chance while limiting fraud and protecting legitimate claims. the aim is not to maximise closures; it is to let resources move while treating workers, creditors and owners fairly. he sinh thai doanh nghiep co the yeu di vi nhieu ly do: dan so gia lam giam so nguoi co the khoi nghiep; nen tang so cung co loi the quy mo; quy dinh lam gia nhap kho hon; han che tin dung can tro mo rong; hoac nha o va ky nang khien nguoi lao dong kho chuyen noi lam. cac co che khac nhau nen can chan doan rieng. du lieu oecd co the chi ra ty le gia nhap hay tai phan bo thap, nhung muon xac dinh nguyen nhan can so sanh nganh, dia diem va thoi gian. cai cach co the lam ty le gia nhap tang dong thoi so vu that bai tang, dieu do khong nhat thiet gay hai neu nguon luc duoc su dung hieu qua hon. sau cai cach, hay theo doi ty le ton tai, tang truong, dich chuyen lao dong va nang suat thay vi chi nhin mot chi so tieu de. business dynamism can weaken for several reasons: population ageing may reduce the number of potential founders; digital platforms can make scale advantages stronger; regulation can make entry harder; credit constraints can prevent expansion; or workers may face housing and skill barriers to moving. the mechanisms differ, so policy requires diagnosis. oecd data can reveal that entry rates or reallocation are lower, but causal evaluation needs comparisons across industries, places and time. a reform may raise entry while also increasing failure rates, which is not automatically harmful if resources are redeployed productively. track survival, growth, worker transitions and productivity after the reform rather than relying on a single headline indicator. voi nguoi khoi nghiep, dong luc kinh doanh chiu anh huong cua dieu kien rat thuc te: thoi gian va chi phi dang ky, kha nang tiep can von, ha tang thanh toan, quy dinh thue ro rang, hop dong duoc thuc thi va kha nang tuyen dung. chinh phu nen cong bo du lieu doanh nghiep theo cach co the so sanh, tham van nhung cong ty da gia nhap, mo rong hoac dong cua. thu tuc mat kha nang thanh toan can de du doan; nen bo quy dinh bao ve doanh nghiep hien huu ma khong co ly do cong ro rang. nhung khong nen tuyen bo rang nhieu cong ty moi luon dem lai nang suat hay muc luong cao hon. du lieu oecd den 2022 va nghien cuu quoc gia moi hon dua ra bang chung huu ich, con dieu kien hien tai co the thay doi nhanh. can hoi cong ty nao phat trien, tao loai viec lam nao va nguon luc co den noi su dung hieu qua hon khong. for an entrepreneur, dynamism is shaped by practical conditions: the time and cost to register, access to finance, payment infrastructure, clear tax rules, enforceable contracts and the ability to hire. for policymakers, publish comparable firm-demography data and consult firms that entered, expanded or closed. make insolvency procedures predictable and remove rules that protect incumbents without a clear public purpose. but avoid claiming that more start-ups always mean higher productivity or better wages. oecd observations to 2022 and newer country studies provide useful evidence, while current conditions can change quickly. a sound judgment asks which firms grow, what jobs they create and whether resources reach more productive uses. voi nguoi khoi nghiep, dong luc kinh doanh phu thuoc thoi gian va chi phi dang ky, von, ha tang thanh toan, quy tac thue ro rang, hop dong co the thuc thi va kha nang tuyen nguoi. chinh phu nen cong bo du lieu doanh nghiep co the so sanh, cai thien thu tuc mat kha nang thanh toan va bo quy dinh bao ve doanh nghiep hien huu neu thieu muc tieu cong ro rang. tuy nhien, nhieu cong ty moi khong tu dong tao nang suat hay luong cao hon. can hoi cong ty nao phat trien, viec lam gi duoc tao ra va nguon luc co chuyen sang noi su dung hieu qua hon khong.

hoang tai chinh lam giam tich luy von tren lao dong; von moi thuong can ky nang va to chuc bo tro. capital deepening means giving each worker more or better productive capital, such as machinery, software, buildings or transport infrastructure. it can raise output per hour when the investment complements workers and is used effectively. a new machine may reduce repetitive tasks, while keeping staffing constant, output may increase. if it hires more people, total output may rise while output per worker stays similar. a capital-services measure tries to capture the productive flow from assets, not just their purchase price. different assets depreciate at different speeds, and software or research may create benefits over years. national accounts and firm data may treat these investments differently. analysts should state whether they mean labour productivity, which relates output to hours, or multifactor productivity, which compares output with a wider bundle of inputs. same systems as large rivals. shared infrastructure, extension services and skills programmes may help, provided they respond to real demand. evaluations should measure productivity, quality, safety and employment effects over a suitable period, not just count equipment purchases. dau tu bo tro thuong quyet dinh cong nghe co tao ra loi ich hay khong. he thong kiem ke so can du lieu san pham chinh
